title: Extraction, identification, and quantification of volatile fatty acids (VFA) in rumen fluid samples using Reverse Phase High-Performance Liquid Chromatography with Diode Array Detector (RP HPLC-DAD)
protocol: Collect at least 50 mL of rumen fluid from a fistulated cattle, sheep or goat, filtering it through three cheese-cloth layers.
Pre-warm the thermos with water at 39 ºC and empty before collecting rumen fluid.
Add 2 mL of previously filtered rumen fluid to a 5 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 2 mL of extraction solution to the centrifuge tube plus rumen fluid and stir in vortex using medium speed for 30 s.
Freeze the sample at -20 ºC until analysis.
If immediately analyzed, refrigerate the tube at 4 ºC for 30 min to allow rumen fluid protein precipitation.
Thaw samples at room temperature (20 ºC) on the day of analysis.
Centrifugate samples at 4,000 rpm for 10 min at room temperature (20 ºC).
Recover the liquid phase after centrifugation using a plastic syringe.
Filter the liquid phase through a 0.45 μm PES membrane filter.
Collect the volume in a plastic tube of 4 mL.
Prepare the calibration curve as described in section 3.3.2.
Analyze each point of the curve by RP HPLC-DAD.
Identify and integrate the resulting chromatographic peaks.
Place 500 μL of the final extract in a chromatographic vial.
Identify and integrate the resulting chromatographic peaks.
